description: Figure 1 presents the distribution of content types within the DODa dataset. The pie chart is divided into six slices, and includes percentage labels directly within each slice. The largest slice, representing 45.387% of the dataset, is labeled “Idioms & Expressions” and is colored a light gray. The next largest slice, at 23.108%, is labeled “Name Databases” and is also light gray. A slice representing 12.45% is labeled “Lexical Correspondences” and is a darker gray. The remaining three slices represent “Special files” at 8.66%, “read/reading” at 5.42%, and “supporting advanced analysis” at 4.93%. The slices are arranged in descending order by percentage, with the largest slice positioned at the top and proceeding clockwise. A legend is not present, but the percentage for each category is clearly indicated within the corresponding slice.
